extracted.name: Mango Tapioca Jelly ✨
extracted.description: Really wanted to know more mango dessert recipes so I found this dessert and made it. Learned it from youtube! By “CRESEL Z. kitchen” Here’s the link: https://youtu.be/f5IZhgztR5A If you wanna watch it in detail ✨
instruction_lines: Make the gelatin. Follow the instructions provided by your chosen gelatin brand
After dissolving the gelatin, add the diced mangoes in the gelatin
Then add the all purpose cream, evaporated milk, condensed milk, and the tapioca pearls
